binders: An arbitrary type Omega equipped with a measurable-space structure.
An instance asserting that mu is a probability measure.
For the pointwise clauses, arbitrary quotient classes x and y in LocalDef002(mu), and an arbitrary real scalar c.
hypotheses: The only theorem-level assumption beyond the measurable-space structure is that mu is a probability measure.

By membership in LocalDef002(mu), each class has a representative X: Omega -> Real that is measurable and has finite LocalDef008(mu,X), with representatives identified modulo an almost-everywhere-zero difference.
conclusions: For every x, LocalDef001(mu,x) is nonnegative.
For every x, LocalDef001(mu,x)=0 if and only if x is the zero quotient class.
For every x and y, LocalDef001(mu,x+y) <= LocalDef001(mu,x)+LocalDef001(mu,y).
For every real c and every x, LocalDef001(mu,c*x)=|c| LocalDef001(mu,x).
mathematical_definitions: For a measurable real-valued function X, define rho_mu(X) as the ENNReal infimum of finite nonzero scales t for which omega |-> exp(X(omega)^2/t.toReal^2) is integrable and has mu-integral at most 2; the formal predicate also repeats measurability of X.
Let V_mu be the real vector space of measurable X: Omega -> Real with rho_mu(X)<infinity.
Let N_mu be the subspace of V_mu consisting of functions equal to zero mu-almost everywhere, and let Q_mu=V_mu/N_mu.
rho_mu is lifted to Q_mu using its invariance under the quotient relation, and LocalDef001(mu,x) is the real conversion of that lifted finite ENNReal value.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every probability measure mu on an arbitrary measurable space, the exponential-square gauge on measurable real-valued functions with finite gauge, after quotienting by equality almost everywhere and converting its finite ENNReal value to Real, satisfies all norm axioms: nonnegativity, value zero at the zero class, definiteness, the triangle inequality, and absolute homogeneity under every real scalar.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The domain is not all functions Omega -> Real: representatives must be measurable and have LocalDef008 value strictly below ENNReal infinity.

The object is a quotient by the submodule of functions equal to zero mu-almost everywhere, so x=0 and equality between x values are quotient equalities, not pointwise equalities of chosen representatives.
Admissible scales explicitly exclude both 0 and ENNReal infinity and additionally require integrability of the exponential-square integrand, not merely that its integral expression is bounded.
LocalDef001 uses ENNReal.toReal. Its intended finite interpretation relies on the finite-gauge restriction built into the representative space.

The conclusion is a conjunction of norm axioms rather than construction of a bundled Norm instance, and it asserts no completeness, separability, inner-product representation, or probabilistic tail/moment bound beyond those axioms.

The theorem quantifies over every probability measure but only after an IsProbabilityMeasure instance is available; contexts admitting no such instance make that particular instance-quantified branch unavailable.

The quotient space is nevertheless nonempty in any admitted probability context because the zero function is explicitly proved measurable with finite gauge, so the elementwise clauses are not vacuous merely from an empty domain.
